# Paul DeLorean
## Paul DeLorean
### Tenure
**Paul Joseph DeLorean** is a Hot Wheels designer who worked at Mattel from 2011 to 2013. The nephew of [John DeLorean](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_DeLorean "wikipedia:John DeLorean") , he designed 10-15 Hot Wheels vehicles. He is currently the owner and CEO of DeLorean Aerospace LLC. DeLorean rejoined Mattel in 2023 on a temporary basis and again in 2025.
